description: Clears a primary calendar by deleting all events from it. The calendar itself is preserved; only its events are removed. Primary calendars cannot be deleted entirely.

calendar_id.description: Primary calendar to clear: "`primary`" or the account's own email address. Google only clears primary calendars; secondary calendar IDs return 400 Invalid Value. To remove a secondary calendar's events, delete them individually or delete the calendar.
calendar_id.human_parameter_description: Use 'primary' (or your own email address) to clear your main calendar. Secondary calendars cannot be cleared.
calendar_id.title: Calendar Id

name: clear_calendar

ClearCalendarResponse.description: Successful response contains no content; the response body is empty. The Calendars: clear method does not return any fields. Some client implementations may include a human-readable confirmation message.

display_url.description: URL to view the calendar in Google Calendar web interface.
display_url.title: Display Url

message.description: Human-readable confirmation that the calendar was cleared successfully. Note: Not part of the official Google Calendar API response; may be present in certain client implementations.
message.title: Message

ClearCalendarResponse.title: GOOGLECALENDAR_CLEAR_CALENDAR Response
